itineraries.title: Black Friday in Downtown Raleigh: Gregg Museum, Gallery C, Historian Walking Tour, True Crime Tour
itineraries.theme: Skip the malls: free art in the morning, two guided walks of downtown history in the afternoon and after dark
itineraries.drive_time: Gregg Museum is on Hillsborough St. (about 2 mi west of downtown); everything else is within about 1 mi of the Capitol. plan on 20-45 min from elsewhere in the Triangle (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Museum and gallery free; two tours $15 each; about $40-$65 per person for meals

morning.title: Community Stories: Sustaining North Carolina’s Black Heritage
morning.location: Gregg Museum of Art & Design, 1903 Hillsborough Street Raleigh, NC 27607
morning.notes: NC State's art museum; exhibition on sustaining Black heritage in North Carolina. Info: https://gregg.arts.ncsu.edu/exhibitions/#upcoming

afternoon.title: Downtown Raleigh Historian Guided Walking Tour
afternoon.location: Raleigh Sheraton Downtown, 420 Fayetteville St, Raleigh, NC 27601
afternoon.notes: About an hour, meeting at the Raleigh Sheraton on Fayetteville St. Info: https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/downtown-raleigh-historian-guided-walking-tour/2026-11-27/

Own lunch menu labels: Falafel $7.95 (gluten-free, vegan), Warak Anab $9.95 (gluten-free, vegan), Lentil & Kale Soup $4.95/$6.95 (vegan), Cheese Rolls $15.95 (vegetarian). food.notes: 222 South Blount Street, Raleigh, NC 27601, on Moore Square. Own contact page: Monday-Saturday 5-10 PM, Sunday 5-9 PM; parking in the Moore Square deck (entrance on Wilmington Street). Own menu key: V = vegetarian. Manda Amphone's Curry with pumpkin (GF/V) $25.90; Crispy Rice Lettuce Wraps (GF/V, contain egg) $17.90; Manda's Herb Salad with fried tofu (marked vegan) $26.90. Book ahead on a tree-lighting night. Menu and hours carried from the 2026-W47 check (fetched 2026-11-19); not re-fetched this run. Bida Manda is on Moore Square, where the 8 PM tour starts.

alternatives.good_weather: Friday forecast: Mostly Cloudy, high near 54°F. Bring a layer for the 8 PM walk.
alternatives.rain: Swap the evening tour for UniverSoul Circus at Coastal Credit Union Music Park, 7 PM ($25-$63.06; event a1fd7826b770), or stay on Moore Square for dinner.

practical_notes: Park in the Moore Square deck (entrance on Wilmington St.) after the Gregg Museum; the gallery, tours and restaurants are walkable from there.
Suggested departure: 9:15 AM to reach the Gregg Museum at opening.
Book tours ahead; both are $15 per person.
itineraries.overview: Skip the malls: free art in the morning, two guided walks of downtown history in the afternoon and after dark. Forecast: Mostly Cloudy, about 54°F. Museum and gallery free; two tours $15 each; about $40-$65 per person for meals.

itineraries.title: Small Business Saturday in Durham: Craft Market, 5 Points Gallery, Houseplant Bingo, A Taste of Saved Messages

itineraries.drive_time: Durham Central Park, 5 Points Gallery and NorthStar are within about 1 mi of each other downtown; For Garden's Sake (NC 751) is about 9 mi south (straight line). plan on 20-45 min from elsewhere in the Triangle (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
